body.sub: Water Drops on a Cold Glass
lines: There is a glass of icy water on the table.
Soon, you can see tiny water drops on the cold glass.
Where do the water drops come from?
The water drops come from the air.
The air around us has water vapor.
The water vapor turns into water drops when it meets something cool, like the cold glass.
You can see condensation in the bathroom, too.
Look at the mirror after a shower.
The mirror is covered with very small water drops.
That is because the warm air meets the cool mirror.
Think of more examples of condensation.
body.text: It is a hot day. There is a glass of icy water on the table. Soon, you can see tiny water drops on the cold glass. Where do the water drops come from? The water drops come from the air. The air around us has water vapor. The water vapor turns into water drops when it meets something cool, like the cold glass. That is called condensation. You can see condensation in the bathroom, too. Look at the mirror after a shower. The mirror is covered with very small water drops. That is because the warm air meets the cool mirror. Think of more examples of condensation. You can find them easily.
